title: Justin and Hailey Bieber spotted in Seongsu-dong again
text:
Justin and Hailey Bieber spotted in Seongsu-dong again 
 Justin and Hailey Bieber spotted in Seongsu-dong again
 News - 25 Oct 2026 
 By PAP Magazine Editorial
 TL;DR 
 Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber have appeared in Seongsu-dong, Seoul, once again. This is not their first time.
 ◎ 
 Follow PAP on Instagram 
 ↗ 
 Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber have appeared in Seongsu-dong, Seoul, once again. This is not their first time. The couple has been spotted around the city repeatedly, drawing attention from local fans and the fashion scene. Seongsu-dong seems to have become a familiar neighborhood for them.
In the photos, Justin wears a beige hoodie paired with a red cap, while Hailey opts for a black jacket and sunglasses for a chic vibe. Hailey's relaxed demeanor, coffee in hand, stands out. Both maintain their signature street style while staying true to their individual aesthetics. It's a lesson in balancing casual comfort with effortless polish.
The Biebers' Seoul outings carry more weight than simple tourism. Seongsu-dong, their frequent haunt, is now considered one of Seoul's hottest fashion and cultural hubs. As global celebrities frequent the area, its status continues to rise.
Among fans, a 'spot the Biebers in Seongsu' challenge is already circulating. Perhaps the chances of bumping into them are genuinely increasing. Do you think a trip to Seongsu-dong might lead to your own Bieber sighting?

 FAQ
 Did Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber show up in Seongsu-dong again? 
 Yes, they did. Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber were recently spotted once more in Seongsu-dong, Seoul. The couple has been visiting various spots around the city, drawing attention from local fans and the fashion scene, with Seongsu-dong becoming one of their go-to destinations.
 What styles were the Biebers wearing in Seongsu-dong? 
 Justin Bieber wore a beige hoodie and red cap, while Hailey Bieber completed a chic look with a black jacket and sunglasses. Both maintained a relaxed streetwear aesthetic while showcasing their individual personalities through their outfits.
 Why is Seongsu-dong a frequent destination for global celebrities? 
 Seongsu-dong is currently considered Seoul's hottest fashion and cultural hub. With its concentration of unique cafés, concept stores, and galleries, the neighborhood attracts global celebrities regularly, further elevating its status and appeal.
